title: BetBazaar
tagline: A prediction market based on the Pari-Mutuel algorithm where participants can create market, place bets on the outcomes of specific events, and the payouts are determined by a pooled betting approach.
description: A prediction market based on the Pari-Mutuel algorithm where participants can create market, place bets on the outcomes of specific events, and the payouts are determined by a pooled betting approach. The project is live and deployed using vercel. Goldsky provides real-time data, ensuring accurate event outcomes.
how_its_made: The BetBazaar prediction market project is built with a Next.js frontend framework and deployed on Base and Mode blockchain.  Goldsky provides real-time data, ensuring accurate event outcomes. Wallet connect is used for making blokchain transcations. Key innovations include optimized gas usage for transactions and frontend caching for improved performance
